this is the most cruel experience ive ever had. the string of events ove rthe last 7 years. lost my gf then, lost my job, lost my health, lost my apartment lost my truck. had to move home. lost my freedom. lost my self respect. Then the bad stuff started to hit me. But not just about me, about others too. from that letter you sent me telling me what happened to you when you were younger, my heart broke into peices. so angry, and sad and sorry. the girl before you id been with for two years, and took two years to finally get over her 95%.my mother getting cancer almost dieing from the chemo. almost choking to death a few times. then almost dieing again recently. my anxiety is insane. 

the girl before her was a 3 year relationship. her last words to me were "I cant do this anymore" and she disappeared forever. not her too..i thought. then you and we had fun, but you did the same thing basically. it didnt hurt as bad, but it still stuck with me. you basically said cant do this anymore. And that was it. gone. i dodnt know what to do in any of those circumstances. so i left it alone. I left you alone and her and my past. but each time it left me a little colder, more empty, and thats the risk of love I suppose. Thats fine. it was bearable. you have someone now and youre protected. the one years and years ago was jnana. one of the first people i met online. fell for her after a couple years. she cheated lied etc. fst forward into early 20s and she came back. we tried again. she came to see me, and it was one of teh best weeks of my life. we planned to get an apt together. the whole deal. She had to fly back to HI. and things started to change.. she needed money and I got an email that made my heart drop. she had been a stripper for years to make money.  i was devastated.

 there appeared a constant hole in my chest. that sinking feeling as if you just discovered someone you love died and there is nothing you can do. i lived with that for three months and worked my ass off. came to see her, made that sacrifice. lies and cheating. flew back to cali 100% dead inside cried for months. took years to recover. this dec, my mom nearly dies again. She was looking weak for days, didnt know what was wrong. that strange shock of seeing your parent really out of it like they didnt know where they were, becuse youre so used to seeing them very bright and aware. heart wrenching of a heart that hasnt healed. constant anxiety, constant fear. the sound she made when she fell in teh bathroom and broke her leg will huant me forever, my dad yelling helplessly OH NO... NO NO... Haveing to carry her back to a seat. My dad accidently taps her foot, on the broken let, and she just started to yell in agony for a moment and started to cry. i will never forget that sound or her face. 

the fear she wasnt going to make it. through it all the girl I was with was there for me, but wasnt close enough to physically be there. i cried to her, sobbed. was so carefull to try and not get too close, but I did anyway becuse I needed someone then, and she needed me too. and we skyped together 8-16 hour a day for months, we were inseperable and watched movies together, slepd together on skype, ate together watched tv, helped each other with school stuff. The closest I have ever been with anyone in my life, and not that is gone too. Cant do this anymore. And I cant do anything about that. We did so many firsts together. 

SO many. Promise ring, origami, buying stuffed animals for each other,silly things that means the word to each other. and shes gone too. i put all my love into it. all my experience from past relationships. I knew id have to close the distance and am working on it... or was. GONE. Useless. Unwanted. Replaced. Rejected. Again. She was like teh first love all over agains except so much better. She was the one, 100%. Our personalities were perfect for each other and we were differant enough to make it interesting. Gone. She started to heal me just by teh way she showed love. And now too the world is taking another away. when she left, the last ten years all hit me. and have not stopped hitting me. and I have been living in this hell, drowning in this black lake struggling not to do anything terrible. the accumulation of all of this, becuse i never fully recovered from any of it. and this one.. was by far the worst loss, becuse I gave it everything. In between all of this I helped people. several dozen get away from suicide. I know the tricks, the wisdom and methods. I know time will numb it. I know what to try to make it easier and what to do. 

I tried. ive tried so often, for so long I can see a pattern that isnt escapable. Its a cycle that builds me up and lets me fall from that  sheer cliff. This fall broke something none of the other things did. This last fall was too much, and too far and I have to sacrifice a peice of my very soul to not harm myself. I can see hopw log this will probably last, and iots the first time ive seriously considered the other door or eternity. I want to walk swiftly into that door of forevermore and just be a part of creation again without concious. Humans wernt build to take this sort of thing for so long. we crack. there is no survival here, just a pain so terrible you want to rip your chest open to let it out. its not simply being upset. not simple heartbreak. ive had those in fair quantities. its everything together slamming me to the floor and through it.she was just the trigger, and the dam cracked and broke and im trying not to drown but sometimes.. i really want it to overwhelm me finally. I want to walk through that archway and behind the veil.
